notes.title: 📣 ​Announcement of Rebranding: "Fontainebleau" is Now "0x0Real Studio"​​ 📣
notes.notes: [p][b]Dear Players,[/b][/p][p][/p][p align="start"]We have some super important news to share—our development team is leveling up![/p][p align="start"]As of today, "Fontainebleau" has officially been renamed to:[/p][h3]✨🎮 ​[b]0x0Real Studio[/b]​ 🎮✨[/h3][p][/p][p align="start"]From our earliest title [i]Meet in Paris[/i]to the subsequent [i]The NOexistenceN of you AND me[/i], and now the upcoming [i]The NOexistenceN of Morphean Paradox: The Forest of Silver Shallots[/i]—we have always strived to tell stories that touch the heart and feel ever closer to "reality."[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]We’ve always held one vision dear:[/p][p align="start"][i]“At the zero point between the virtual and the real, we create authentic tales that belong to both players and characters.”[/i][/p][p align="start"]We aim to explore more gameplay styles and narrative possibilities, because we believe that games are not just about “virtual characters”—they can make you feel:[/p][p align="start"][b]​​“She feels just like a real person.”​[/b][/p][p align="start"]​[/p][p align="start"]It is your support, encouragement, and passion that have brought us this far and given us the courage to keep experimenting![/p][p align="start"]While our name has changed, our heart remains the same. We sincerely thank you all for your ongoing understanding and support![/p][p align="start"]Moving forward, ​[b]0x0Real Studio[/b]​ will continue to journey with you and create stories full of warmth.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]———————[/b][/p][p align="start"][b]​0x0Real Studio​[/b][/p][p align="start"][b]August 29, 2025[/b][/p]

notes.title: The NOexistenceN of you AND me now supports Russian, Brazilian, and Indonesian!
notes.notes:
Hello! We are very excited to announce that 《The NOexistenceN of you AND me》 now supports localization in Russian, Brazilian Portuguese, and Indonesian!

These language versions were passionately contributed by community players, whose support and efforts have allowed Lilith's story to reach even more people. We extend our heartfelt thanks to all the contributors~

In addition, some localization work is still ongoing:

Voice Acting: [list] [*] Portuguese (Brazil) [/list]

Languages: [list] [*] Turkish [*] Spanish (Latin America) [*] Ukrainian [/list]

[h2]Also, there's one more thing![/h2]

Do you remember the great adventure with Lilith in the Silver Onion Forest—meeting scholars, fighting side by side, and finally defeating the Demon King…

But that was just a demo…

[b]A game without a complete world setting, without more characters, without battles and skills, without map exploration, without rich side quests and adventure stories, and without free decisions.[/b]

That’s not even really a demo!! (Sorry, Lilith)

But the good news is—We are actively developing the second part of the 《The NOexistenceN》 series. This time, Lilith will take you on an even more exciting and complete adventure!

Stay tuned~
